name: Minimax Prefix-Suffix Realignment
description: Replaces the explicit time-based sequential scheduling mechanics (a 2-machine flow-shop makespan) with its exact mathematical equivalent: a minimax problem over the sum of a prefix of the first variable and a suffix of the second. This preserves the exact objective function and applicability of Johnson's rule while completely stripping away the characteristic timeline, machine, and phase-dependency vocabulary that models rely on to recognize the flow-shop structure.
